levels: at risk — known gap likely to hurt users or review
proven — google-quality, evidenced end to end

spec.instructions: Rate SPEC conformance: does the evidence show the product delivers exactly what was requested — every requested outcome present and working, and no unrequested features, UI, or rewrites added?

design.instructions: Rate DESIGN: one owner per piece of state, concerns in separate modules, a change to one behavior landing in one obvious place — or a grown app still living in one or two giant files?

correctness.instructions: Rate CORRECTNESS: was behavior exercised through the real surface (browser/CLI/service) rather than re-read — boundary, empty-input, ordering, async, cleanup and state-sync failures hunted and fixed?

quality.instructions: Rate QUALITY/concision: no unnecessary lines, branches, abstractions, dead scaffolding, or duplicated logic; formatting clean; the smallest version that keeps the proven behavior.

security.instructions: Rate SECURITY/privacy against the free-public mission: no secrets in the tree, CSP/headers sane, sensitive actions (geolocation, auto-runs) only on explicit user consent, no lead-collection or paywall creep. Evidence facts state what was checked.

performance.instructions: Rate PERFORMANCE: warm same-location interactions are instant, no redundant network re-pulls (weather/NASA memoized), and the first paint stays light. Cite only what the evidence describes.

accessibility.instructions: Rate ACCESSIBILITY: keyboard reachability, labels/ARIA on the calculator controls, contrast, and reduced-motion respect across the main flows described in the evidence.

i18n.instructions: Rate I18N: locale parity for user-visible strings (all locales carry the same keys), no hardcoded English leaking into non-English locales, and locale switching covering the main flows.

seo.instructions: Rate SEO from the code-owned gate evidence only: sitemap, JSON-LD, metadata and character checks green means proven; a red gate means failing; no run recorded means unverified.

resilience.instructions: Rate RESILIENCE of the delivery path: transient-failure retry classification, nested timeout budgets that provably fit, and stuck-run recovery — as evidenced, not aspired.

experience.instructions: Rate EXPERIENCE: first-run clarity within moments, actions acknowledging themselves, errors saying what to do next, empty states inviting rather than confusing, coherent spacing/hierarchy.

docs.instructions: Rate DOCS: architecture and runbook match the code as it now stands (module ownership, gate inventory, deploy steps) — not stale descriptions of removed behavior.

testing.instructions: Rate TESTING from the code-owned evidence only: a green full unit suite means proven, a red suite means failing, no recorded run means unverified.

release.instructions: Rate RELEASE readiness from code-owned facts only: CI green, browser smoke green, and a clean tree mean proven; any recorded red means at risk; unknowns mean unverified.

physics.instructions: Rate PHYSICS/determinism of the sizing engine: hourly irradiance derivations deterministic, thresholds intact (none weakened), and live-model validation status as stated in the evidence.

spec_gap.label: Spec conformance gap
spec_gap.suggested_next_action: Run the four-dimension audit pass against the request as written: list every unrequested addition to remove and every requested outcome that is not yet present and working.

design_gap.label: Design / ownership gap
design_gap.suggested_next_action: Run the architecture pass: name the state each module owns, move misplaced logic to its owner, and extract the next cohesive unit from any file still acting as a second application controller.

correctness_gap.label: Correctness gap
correctness_gap.suggested_next_action: Run the adversarial exercise pass through real entry points: hunt boundary, ordering, async and state-sync failures, fix only substantiated defects, then re-run the failing flows.

quality_gap.label: Concision / formatting gap
quality_gap.suggested_next_action: Run the deletion-first pass: npx prettier --write the red files, then delete redundancy, one-use indirection and unrequested branches; re-run focused checks after pruning.

security_gap.label: Security / consent gap
security_gap.suggested_next_action: Run the adversarial pass over security surfaces: confirm no secret is tracked, headers/CSP intact, and every sensitive action stays behind explicit user consent; fix what contradicts that.

perf_gap.label: Performance gap
perf_gap.suggested_next_action: Run the playtest pass on the real surface: measure the slow interaction, confirm warm-cache paths issue zero redundant network pulls, and make subsequent adjustments instant.

a11y_gap.label: Accessibility gap
a11y_gap.suggested_next_action: Run the experience-polish pass focused on accessibility: keyboard through every main flow, label the calculator controls, fix contrast, and verify reduced-motion behavior.

i18n_gap.label: Localization gap
i18n_gap.suggested_next_action: Pin locale parity as a behavioral test (every locale carries every user-visible key), fix the drifting strings it exposes, and keep the parity check green.

seo_gap.label: SEO gate gap
seo_gap.suggested_next_action: Run npm run seo, fix whatever it reports (sitemap, JSON-LD, metadata, characters), and record the green run as evidence.

resilience_gap.label: Delivery resilience gap
resilience_gap.suggested_next_action: Run the adversarial pass over the delivery path: prove inner retry/timeout budgets fit every outer cap, classification covers transport failures end to end, and stuck runs recover — including the page-side run deadline: a share-restore auto-run that never gets a worker reply must surface an honest retryable error instead of hanging forever (reproduced on production 2026-09-23; no run deadline/watchdog/error state exists anywhere in assets/js).

experience_gap.label: User experience gap
experience_gap.suggested_next_action: Run the experience-polish pass: walk the first-run flow, make actions acknowledge themselves, give errors a next step, and invite rather than confuse in empty states.

docs_gap.label: Documentation drift
docs_gap.suggested_next_action: Run the architecture pass's documentation step: reconcile ARCHITECTURE and the deploy runbook with the code as it stands, deleting descriptions of behavior that no longer exists.

tests_gap.label: Test suite gap
tests_gap.suggested_next_action: Get the full unit suite green (npm test), add behavioral contracts for any behavior that changed without one, and never weaken a gate to get there.

release_gap.label: Release readiness gap
release_gap.suggested_next_action: Run the release-candidate pass: ship in-flight work through the protected path, get CI and browser smoke green on the merge, and re-run this gate on the clean tree.

physics_gap.label: Physics / determinism gap
physics_gap.suggested_next_action: Pin the physics contract with tests: deterministic derivations, thresholds intact, and a recorded verify:live run — fix any assertion the evidence shows weakened.
